_comment: Vendor CAD files used to render part sprites (see README.md). 'axes' gives the CAD axis for the part's x (out of the optic's front face), y (your right when facing the optic) and z (up); 'origin_mm' is the CAD point that becomes the part origin. Alignments were measured from each file's mounting holes and bores. 'material' (optional) replaces the file's colours with a renderer material, since Thorlabs STEP files are single-colour. The STEP files themselves are not committed.

KM100CP._note: metric KM100CP/M file: identical body, M4 instead of 8-32 taps

KM100BP._note: origin: pellicle axis (1.05in from the bottom and the +x face) above the bottom #8 hole

KB1X1._note: origin: centre of the top face

CP35._note: origin: optic axis on the front face

SM1ZB._note: drawn with the housing down; origin: optic axis at mid-plate (under the top 8-32 hole)

PH2._note: origin: post axis on the table; thumbscrew toward +y

PH2@BE1._note: the same PH2 standing on a BE1 (0.185in higher)

CF125C._note: CF125 file: same body as the CF125C minus the captive screw; origin: pedestal centre, heel foot on the table
